Staff UI & Web Performance Engineer at Linear
Location: Remote / New York, NY

About the Role:
We are looking for a Staff Frontend Engineer with deep mastery of React, TypeScript, and high-performance WebGL/canvas rendering.
You will lead our next-generation web client rendering engine, build component systems for fast keyboard navigation, and optimize client latency.

Requirements:
- 8+ years building high-scale web client applications
- Deep expertise in React, TypeScript, and modern browser performance profiling
- Experience building WebGL or canvas-based rendering pipelines
- Proven track record creating reusable design system component libraries
